_meta.source: curated starter subset — the full 187-entry help ships in VM Manager's Install.dhp and is not bundled here. Parameters without an entry render with no inline help (never a fabricated description).

pbx_type.description: The PBX model this Stratagy is integrated with (selects the dial-code/integration template).

password.description: System administration password (max 8 chars, case-sensitive). The shipped default 'Stratagy' is a security finding.

hot_box.description: Mailbox a caller reaches immediately on connect (the 'hot' box).

error_box.description: Mailbox that handles callers who make repeated errors.

box_snd.description: System-send mailbox used for broadcast / future delivery.

defaults_box.description: Template mailbox (997) copied into every newly created User ID.

security_max_length.description: Maximum number of digits a mailbox security code may have.

security_min_length.description: Minimum number of digits a mailbox security code must have.

baud1.description: Baud rate of serial port 1 (the maintenance port).

serial_port1.description: Which physical serial port is port 1.

lognam.description: Filename of the Stratagy activity log on the card.

shutdown.description: Scheduled automatic shutdown/restart time, as 'DAY HHMM' (day 0=Sunday).

fixed_len0.description: Fixed User ID digit length for boxes whose first digit is 0.

fixed_len1.description: Fixed User ID digit length for boxes whose first digit is 1.

fixed_len2.description: Fixed User ID digit length for boxes whose first digit is 2.

max_prompt.description: Maximum number of times a prompt is replayed before timeout.

tmo_idle.description: Idle timeout (seconds) before the system hangs up a quiet caller (0 = none).

tmo_menu.description: Seconds to wait for a menu selection before timing out.

tape_length.description: Maximum total recording time (minutes) across all mailboxes.

play_caller_id.description: Announce the caller ID when playing a message.

active_hold.description: Allow callers to be placed on active hold.

country_code.description: Country code used when expanding notify/AMIS phone numbers.
